property_summary: For any caller, only the account returned by owner() (i.e. the deployer after initialization) may successfully call updateRoundImplementation; replacing msg.sender with tx.origin breaks this because a proxied call from a contract (msg.sender != tx.origin) would be allowed only in the buggy contract, allowing a different origin to update roundImplementation.
change_summary: Change the onlyOwner check to compare owner() against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, allowing calls that are proxied differently to pass and thus enabling different callers to update roundImplementation.
